props.gloss_en: the mishna (117b.2): one rescues food for three meals
the mishna (120a.2): one rescues a basket full of loaves, even if it holds a hundred meals
Rav Huna: here [our mishna] -- of one who comes to rescue
Rav Huna: there [the three-meal mishna] -- of one who comes to collect
Rav Huna: one who comes to rescue rescues all of it
Rav Huna: one who comes to collect collects only food for three meals
Rav: both [mishnayot] are of one who comes to collect
Rav: here -- to the same courtyard (that 'here' is our mishna is Steinsaltz's assignment)
Rav: there -- to another courtyard (that 'there' is the three-meal mishna is Steinsaltz's assignment)
Rav Huna brei deRav Yehoshua: if he spread his cloak and collected and set down, collected and set down -- is he like one who comes to rescue, or like one who comes to collect?
resolved: he is like one who comes to rescue, and it is well
Rav Chisda expounded: provided he does not bring a vessel holding more than three meals
Rava: Rav Sheizvi misled Rav Chisda [into that derasha]
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak to Rava: what is the error?
the baraita: provided he does not bring another vessel and catch, another vessel and join
Rava: it is another vessel that is not [allowed]; but in that same vessel he rescues as much as he wants

supports.gloss_en: מדאמר רבא אטעייה רב שיזבי לרב חסדא -- since Rava calls the three-meal vessel limit an error, one who gathers into one vessel is like one who comes to rescue (inference from Rava's wording; no תא שמע)
דקתני ובלבד שלא יביא כלי אחר -- כלי אחר הוא דלא, אבל בההוא מנא כמה דבעי מציל
the error is the size limit: the baraita forbids only another vessel, so in one vessel any amount may be rescued

objections.gloss_en: והא תנא ליה רישא שלש סעודות ותו לא! -- the earlier mishna allowed food for three meals and no more; how then a basket of a hundred meals?
